LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyLaunch.description: Use the cockpit console to initiate an immediate emergency launch. The Hellion will land at a random nearby location and suffer a guaranteed mishap; anyone outside the airframe will be left behind.
LanguageData.VGE_AnalyzeTheStars.description: Use a telescope and surviving USSA charts to identify a new orbital location nearby.
LanguageData.VGE_EngineeringCommand.description: Coordinate nearby crew during Hellion construction and maintenance. The command improves their work while the effect remains active for the next 24 hours.
